title: Environment Configuration
description: Configure .NET and React apps safely across development, staging, and production.

data.text:
**Environment Configuration**

Separating configuration from code lets you move apps between environments without changing source code.

items: User Secrets: local development secrets (not committed)
Never expose secrets in client-side env vars

data.title: React .env.example
data.content:
REACT_APP_API_URL=https://api.example.com
REACT_APP_API_TIMEOUT=30000
# Never put secrets here - they ship to the browser!

data.title: Client-Side Secrets Are Not Secret
data.text: Anything in REACT_APP_* is bundled into JavaScript and visible to anyone. Never put API keys or database credentials there.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Never trust client-side env vars with secrets
data.takeaway: Good environment configuration makes deployments safer and more repeatable.
